# SiriusPoint named Carrier of the Year 2026


-


09/03/26


A fantastic evening in London last night as SiriusPoint was named Carrier of the Year at the Insurance Insider Honours.


Insurance Insider said:


> “The judges were impressed by this winner’s remarkable transformation, combining strong financial performance, outstanding client service and a clear, people-focused culture to reshape its reputation across the market.”


Congratulations to everyone at SiriusPoint who contributed to this achievement, and thank you to our partners who joined us for an evening of celebration.


Written by SiriusPoint
